summary: iter322 verification — 3 bug fixes (admin password reset 60-min expiry, FRONTEND_URL env var, admin-verify admin_verified key) + interactive chat (admin reply, user reply, user-side SSE) all PASS. 28/28 backend tests green + UI smoke verified the full admin reply flow end-to-end on the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Reply endpoint returns 400 (not 422) for empty/oversized message — likely a global validation_exception_handler in server.py converts Pydantic 422→400. Functionally identical (both are validation errors), but Pydantic's native 422 is more idiomatic. Low priority.

/api/admin/users/{id}/reset-password response body is {success, email_sent} only — does NOT echo the token or reset URL. Callers who need to surface the token (e.g., support page widget) cannot. Consider returning {token, expires_at, reset_url} for the admin-flow.

admin_user_management.py line 426 still has hardcoded `https://bidvex.com` as the FRONTEND_URL fallback. While the env var IS read now (fixing the bug), the fallback should match the per-env default or be a noop (empty). Low risk in current deployment since FRONTEND_URL is always set.

rca_of_the_issue: All 3 bug fixes RCAs confirmed: (A) line 420 of admin_user_management.py was `datetime.now(...).isoformat()` with no `+ timedelta(hours=1)` → token expired at creation → verify-reset-token rejected; fix adds 1h. (B) email_templates.password_reset_email built reset_url with `https://bidvex.com` hardcoded → broke on preview; fix uses os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL'). (C) admin.py admin-verify endpoint read payload['verified'] but EnhancedUserManager sends {admin_verified: true}; fix reads either key (`admin_verified` preferred, `verified` legacy).
